name: Kody
tagline: A personal assistant that keeps each user’s memory, tools, secrets, and automations isolated.
hook: A 73-line index routes proposals through decision records and higher-risk changes through realistic preview testing.
summary: Kody keeps its root instructions as a navigation layer over focused contributor documentation and skills. The index names one authoritative validation command, directs new product surfaces through prior decisions, and separates preview testing and cloud-agent setup from general repository guidance.

techniques.title: Use one authoritative local gate
techniques.body: The index names a single validation command instead of repeating the individual checks it contains. Contributors have one place to start, while detailed setup and testing guidance remains in linked documents.
techniques.quote: `npm run validate` is the single authoritative local gate.

techniques.title: Read prior decisions before proposing a new surface
techniques.body: Decision records are presented as a list of steering vetoes, with a trigger to read them before proposing a primitive or surface. This routes design work through earlier constraints before implementation starts.
techniques.quote:
- Decision records (steering veto list — open before proposing a new primitive
  or surface):
  [docs/contributing/decisions/index.md](./docs/contributing/decisions/index.md)

techniques.title: Tie preview testing to risk and realistic state
techniques.body: Manual preview testing is called out for medium- and high-risk work and specifies a logged-in user with data. The index pairs a contributor document with a dedicated skill so the workflow can be loaded when that work needs it.
techniques.quote:
- Manual PR preview testing (medium/high risk, logged-in user + data):
- [docs/contributing/preview-manual-testing.md](./docs/contributing/preview-manual-testing.md)
  and the
  [preview-manual-test skill](./.agents/skills/preview-manual-test/SKILL.md)

techniques.title: Move cloud-environment gotchas into a focused guide
techniques.body: The cloud-specific section names runtime setup, browser-install hangs, seeding, and local limitations. It sends those environment details to a separate reference rather than mixing them into every contributor instruction.
techniques.quote:
Cloud Agent VM gotchas (Node 26 on `PATH`, the Playwright browser-install hang
and manual workaround, dev server, seeding, and local limitations) live in a
dedicated reference:

steal: Expose a single authoritative local validation command.
Route new design proposals through the decisions that constrain them.
Specify realistic user state and a risk threshold for manual preview tests.
Keep environment-specific setup and failure workarounds in a dedicated guide.
